articles.title: Treasury yields fall after Democrats win House and Senate majorities
articles.description: Treasury yields moved lower on Wednesday as investors weighed big wins from Democrats in the U.S. midterm elections.

articles.title: McDonald's earnings beat, but traffic to its U.S. restaurants falls
articles.description: McDonald's has leaned into discounts to attract budget-conscious diners over the last two years.

articles.title: Canton’s CC rises 4% as SEC staff view it as ‘digital commodity’
articles.description: SEC staff’s no-action letter covers CC earned by running infrastructure and applications, but is not a binding ruling on its legal status.

articles.title: Wayfair sales jump 10% as furniture retailer says it's winning share of sluggish market
articles.description: Wayfair said its sales jumped 10% in the third quarter as the retailer posted its strongest quarter since the pandemic.

articles.title: Mortgage rates drop for the third straight week, but homebuyers are still leaving the market
articles.description: Mortgage rates came down again last week, but mortgage demand from homebuyers continued to decline, as high home prices and inflation stretch affordability.

articles.title: Midterms Blue Wave Makes $917K for One Polymarket Trader, If Alaska Doesn’t Flip
articles.description: A Polymarket trader topped the prediction market’s leaderboard after Democrats swept the US midterms, but Alaska could still flip it.

articles.title: CVS to split off drugstore business in major breakup of healthcare giant
articles.description: The move would reverse the company's $78 billion acquisition of Aetna, and dismantle the vertically integrated healthcare conglomerate it created in 2018.

articles.title: SpaceX, Tesla fall over 4% on Democrats' big win; AI stocks mixed
articles.description: AI fortunes were mixed as premarket trading opened on Wednesday.

articles.title: ZachXBT Names French Bank Crédit Mutuel Arkéa as Alleged Victim of $133M Crypto Theft
articles.description: The onchain investigator says the theft is being "covered up," and that a lack of disclosure let more than $30 million be laundered.

articles.title: Binance hack may be ‘temporary setback’ for crypto, Grayscale’s Pandl says
articles.description: Zach Pandl highlighted institutional custody safeguards as crypto markets recovered some losses following the record $6.3 billion Binance hack.

articles.title: Elon Musk’s record election bet backfired. The backlash may reach beyond one billionaire

articles.title: Euro zone inflation hits 4% for first time in three years as interest rate hike looms

articles.title: U.S. midterm elections in pictures: Democrats' sweeping victories deliver rebuke to Trump

articles.title: Novo shares jump as Wegovy pill sales impress, drugmaker hikes outlook

articles.title: Bitcoin rebounds from midterm dip as DeFi leads gains

articles.title: Judge Orders Bitcoin Wallet Returned to Family of Convicted Canadian Killer
articles.description: A Nova Scotia judge found prosecutors failed to link William Sandeson's Bitcoin to the 2015 murder of fellow student Taylor Samson.

articles.title: Justin Sun seeks $264K sanctions over World Liberty’s UAE disclosure
articles.description: Sun plans to refile his token-freeze lawsuit in California state court after the sanctions motion is resolved. A hearing is set for Dec. 10.

articles.description: Blockchain sleuth ZachXBT says the French bank may have lost more than $133 million from crypto exchange accounts. Crypto.com confirms it has blocked funds linked to the theft.

articles.title: Bitcoin ETFs lose $1.16B as Bitwise calls selling ‘short-term’
articles.description: Bitwise’s André Dragosch attributed Bitcoin ETF outflows to weaker market sentiment, saying institutions have largely maintained their exposure.
